content.short: Polymesh is an institutional-grade, permissioned Layer 1 blockchain designed specifically for regulated assets.
content.description: Polymesh is a leading institutional-grade Layer 1 blockchain engineered to overcome the barriers to adopting security tokens and regulated digital assets. Unlike general-purpose networks, Polymesh is a permissioned blockchain that bakes identity, compliance, and confidentiality directly into the core runtime. This approach ensures all participants are verified and transactions meet rigorous regulatory standards, making it a primary venue for capital markets. The network is powered by the POLYX token, providing a robust framework for the tokenization and settlement of RWAs.
content.meta: Polymesh provides a permissioned Layer 1 blockchain for regulated assets. Discover Polymesh and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
